sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Positives first: tiny topper with big flavour. A small sprinkle can make simple meals feel more complete. Easy to use across lots of foods. Works well in savoury dishes, baking, and toppings. Strong wholefood seed identity. Feels like a very legitimate seed-category food rather than an edge case.

closing.summary: Big strengths are magnesium, omega 3, and protein, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low protein quality, and low starch. It's good for bone health, blood and oxygen support, and heart health because calcium and magnesium can support bones, iron supports the blood-and-oxygen side, and fibre is useful for heart health.
